name: Contextual Relevance
description: Measures how well the response is related to the given context.

name: Interesting Fact Integration
description: Evaluates how well the response incorporates the interesting fact.

name: Engagement
description: Assesses the response's ability to engage the user in the conversation.

name: Coherence
description: Measures how logical and coherent the response is.

name: Originality
description: Evaluates the uniqueness and creativity of the response.

name: Fluency
description: Assesses the response's language quality and fluency.
